newsitem.title: UK: Rank sells Rank Precision for 73 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Rank sells Rank Precision for 73 mln stg.

text.p: The Rank Organisation Plc said on Monday it had sold Rank Precision Industries (RPI) to Schroder Ventures for 72 million stg.
In a statement, the company said the consideration comprised 63 million stg in cash and loan notes of nine million stg and could be subject to completion adjustments.
Rank said RPI consisted of four businesses, Taylor Hobson, Strand Lighting, Cintel and Brimar. It said the sale did not include the digital projection business that was formerly part of Brimar.
Rank said the loan notes would bear a market rate of interest and would be redeemed when Schroders sold Strand Lighting or when it was floated.
Rank said it would use cash proceeds to reduce borrowing.
RPI saw turnover of 114 million stg in the year ending December 31, 1995, with pretax profit before interest of 2.5 million stg.
It had net operating assets of around 69 million stg at December 31, 1995.
Rank has said it would focus on leisure retailing and film and entertainment services after a strategic review earlier this year.
